text: US stocks rebounded sharply Monday after Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, with the S&P 500 up 4.8% to 7,243.94 and the Nasdaq up 6.5%, its best day since April 2025. The Dow gained 1,447.98 points, or 3.0%, to 49,595.31. Nvidia jumped about 31%, and other chip and AI-related names also rallied, recovering part of last week's selloff that pushed the S&P 500 and Dow into correction territory. The TSX closed at 34,081.44, up 2.7% and its biggest daily gain since April 2025, led by materials and technology while energy fell. The STOXX 600 rose 1.8% in Europe, Japan was closed for a holiday, and Asia was mixed, with the Kospi down 3.3%, Taiwan up 2.2% and the Hang Seng down 0.1%.
mood: Relief rally: Nvidia's CEO reversal sparked a sharp rebound in AI and chip stocks after last week's selloff, though Korea lagged and the move was described by one strategist as a short-covering bounce.

veqt.t: S&P 500 +4.8%, Nasdaq +6.5%, Dow +3.0%, led by Nvidia's 31% jump.
TSX rose 2.7% to 34,081.44, led by materials (+6.4%) and technology (+4.4%) while energy fell 1.5%.
STOXX 600 +1.8% on a tech-led rebound; Japan's market was closed for a holiday, and other European and Asia-Pacific closes were not confirmed.
Hang Seng -0.1% and Kospi -3.3%, while Taiwan's TAIEX rose 2.2% and China's CSI 300 gained 0.1%.
